---
name: Tool idea
about: Suggest a new tool for Toolhub
title: "[idea] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What should the tool do?**
One or two sentences.

**Who's it for?**
Who would reach for this tool, and why?

**Can it run entirely in the browser?**
Most Toolhub tools are client-only (free, private, no server cost). If this
one needs an external API, note whether that API offers a free/keyless tier.

**Are you planning to build it yourself?**
If yes, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) — happy to have the PR.
